name: Rich text
description: A rich-text editor with bold, italic, underline, headings, lists, quotes and links, a character counter and strict sanitising of everything typed, pasted or dropped.

props.name: placeholder
props.label: Placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty editor, e.g. Describe the problem.

props.name: max_length
props.label: Maximum characters
props.description: Counted on the plain text. A counter shows the length; longer text is refused.

output.description: The text as sanitised HTML (or plain text, as the form chooses); <key>_text is always the plain text

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the formatting toolbar (Left / Right / Home / End move between buttons, Enter or Space applies one), Tab again to the text. In the text: Ctrl/Cmd+B, I, U for bold, italic, underline; Ctrl/Cmd+K adds a link (Enter applies, Escape cancels); Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z redoes.

author: UserTasks
